response: Let me set up the balance algorithm. For each row, adjust unit columns to absorb residual while respecting min/max, then set column I to 0.

tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Sheet1']
mins=[ws.cell(20,c).value for c in range(2,7)]
maxs=[ws.cell(21,c).value for c in range(2,7)]
for r in range(2,19):
    units=[ws.cell(r,c).value for c in range(2,7)]
    res=ws.cell(r,9).value
    new=list(units)
    rem=res
    order = range(5) if res>=0 else range(4,-1,-1)
    for i in order:
        if rem==0: break
        if units[i]==0: continue
        if res>0:
            cap=maxs[i]-units[i]
            add=min(cap,rem)
            new[i]+=add
            rem-=add
        else:
            cap=units[i]-mins[i]
            sub=min(cap,-rem)
            new[i]-=sub
            rem+=sub
    print(r, res, units, '->', new, 'rem', rem)
"

response: All residuals absorbed fully. Let me write these values into the workbook and set column I to 0.

maxs=[ws.cell(21,c).value for c in range(2,7)]
for r in range(2,19):
    units=[ws.cell(r,c).value for c in range(2,7)]
    res=ws.cell(r,9).value
    new=list(units)
    rem=res
    order = range(5) if res>=0 else range(4,-1,-1)
    for i in order:
        if rem==0: break
        if units[i]==0: continue
        if res>0:
            add=min(maxs[i]-units[i],rem)
            new[i]+=add; rem-=add
        else:
            sub=min(units[i]-mins[i],-rem)
            new[i]-=sub; rem+=sub
    for c in range(2,7):
        ws.cell(r,c,new[c-2])
    ws.cell(r,9,0)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
"
